about.text: A fermented milk of the Abagusii people of the Kisii highlands in south-western Kenya, made from boiled cow's milk soured in a gourd.

links.name: Lactic acid bacteria and yeasts involved in the fermentation of amabere amaruranu, a Kenyan fermented milk

facts.v: Traditional samples average 4.00; 4.54 after 96 h (gourd); lab 3.64 in gourd
Enterobacteriaceae below 1 log in gourd, 2.2 log in plastic
